title: Ɔdansefo a Ogyina Pii
intro: Asɛm bi a emu dɔ da adi, na ɛda ɔmanfo bi bo a enhinhim wɔ atirimɔdensɛm kɛse anim no adi. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ gyidi ho adanse, bere mpo a wohyia afɔrebɔ a etwa to no. Saa kyerɛwtohɔ yi kae yɛn tumi a gyidi wɔ de ko tia nhyɛso a ɛboro so.
clues: Na yɛyɛ kuw bi a wɔka wɔn asɛm no ho asɛm wɔ surah tiawa bi a tumi wom mu, de kɔkɔbɔ ma wɔ ɔtaa ho.
Yehyiaa sodifo bi a na ɔpɛ sɛ otu gyidi a yɛwɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn Baako, Ahengua no Awurade, Nea Ɔfata Ayeyi no ase.
Wɔde sɔhwɛ a ɛyɛ hu a ɛfa amoa kɛse bi a wotutuu wɔ asase mu ho mu.
Yɛhwɛɛ sɛnea wɔtow gyidifo a nkokoaa ka ho guu ogyaframa a ano yɛ den mu wɔ saa amoa no mu no.
Wɔdome yɛn ayayadefo no wɔ wɔn nneyɛe ho, bere a wɔhyɛɛ yɛn bɔ sɛ yebenya akatua kɛse wɔ yɛn pintinnyɛ ho.
Mmɔden a sodifoɔ no bɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛdum yɛn gyidie no maa yɛn gyinabea yɛɛ den sɛ agyidifoɔ wɔ Allah a ɔyɛ adeɛ nyinaa ho adansefoɔ no ani so.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
